Play the unit you possess: Terraria-styl: Play the unit you possess: Terraria-style hotbar, inventory, equipment and HUD. Library for other mods.
pl_key_inventory: Inventory key (Unity KeyCode name, e.g. I, Tab)
pl_scroll_hotbar: Mouse wheel selects hotbar slots (Ctrl+wheel zooms)
pl_hide_native_tips: Hide the game's possession key tips
pl_enable_ground_items: Items on the ground (drop and pick up)
pl_drop_on_death: Units drop their inventory when they die
pl_ai_weapon_switch: AI units switch between carried weapons
possesslib_inventory_button_tip: Open this unit's inventory (no possession needed).
possesslib_trash_tip: Drop an item here to delete it. You can take back the last one until something replaces it.
possesslib_sort_tip: Stack and sort the inventory (the hotbar is not touched).
possesslib_coins_tip: The unit's own money. Spent on food in cities and on crafting.
possesslib_armor_tip: Defense from your gear and traits (the unit's armor stat).
possesslib_equip_tip: Drag gear here, or right-click it in the inventory.
possesslib_tip_eat: Select it and left-click to eat.
possesslib_tip_use: Select it and left-click to use.
possesslib_tip_resource: Resource. Used for crafting and trade.
possesslib_missing_item_tip: The mod that adds this item is not loaded. It is kept safe until it is.
possesslib_toast_full_ground: Inventory full: it fell on the ground
possesslib_toast_cursed_weapon: Cursed! You can't let go of $0.
possesslib_toast_mcmod_conflict: <color=#FF8080>Main Character Mod is also enabled: disable one of them.</color>
